scope: Separately preregistered additional40, original40/additional40/combined80 filtered pending report, and expansion guide links
inventory_note: Included paths are relative to the study directory. SHA-256 covers exported bytes. This manifest excludes its own hash. The existing publication manifest is modified only to refresh the two guide hashes; historical results and cohort labels are preserved.

selection.method: Original repository quotas capped by unseen availability; weighted deterministic redistribution; seeded sampling within repository input-length rank strata. Selection precedes image availability checks and additional outcomes.
selection.deadline_policy: Exact original primary epochs inherited; no extension

runner_checkpoint: Additional runner started waiting for primary official scoring, primary Flash release and all 40 canonical images; no additional generation at the reporting checkpoint

included.source_copy: byte-identical diagnostic source only; actual diagnostic output excluded
byte-identical canonical image tags; no host cache status or image IDs
Filtered report regenerated by publisher without Git flags; incomplete-snapshot label
Filtered report regenerated by publisher without Git flags; no final claim
Public guide with brief expansion links; original protocol retained
Public guide with expansion ownership, deadlines and publication boundaries

excluded: preparation launch/status/lock/log files and host Docker inspection records
extra-campaign/, campaign/, runs/, frozen/ and private/ generated trees
Raw datasets, issue text, gold/source/test patches, hidden evaluator scripts and responses
Agent trajectories, request logs, credentials, machine-local configurations and telemetry
Actual failure-audit.json and diagnostic stdout; these may contain free-text errors or exit messages
reproduction_gaps: The public metadata deliberately lacks the host-only seal and canonical evaluator. Private assets and cached task images are required for wrapper initialization; source export is not a runnable live-run snapshot.
The report publisher must run from the private study copy with reporting ledgers/frozen original manifest present. Only the two filtered report files are copied publicly.
Additional frozen protocol/deadline comparisons remain unverified until its run initializes; they are not inferred equal from intent.
Unknown outcomes suppress final comparison statistics. Original40, additional40 and combined80 labels remain distinct.
audit_swe_failures.py can expose free-text errors and exit messages even without snippets; its outputs are not public-safe by default.
The initial pending report is timestamped and will lag active scoring. Later reviewed refreshes must update report hashes and integration status.
